hook: Telangana pays *Rs 5.59 crore* to 214 surrendered Maoists
hook_b: Telangana pays *Rs 5.59 crore* to 214 surrendered Maoists
tldr: DGP C.V. Anand released pending cash rewards to 214 former CPI (Maoist) members under the state's surrender and rehabilitation policy.

beats.what: Total cash rewards released so far reach Rs 17.68 crore for 659 cadres; Rs 22.31 crore is sanctioned for 755.
beats.why: The policy aims to bring surrendered cadres back into mainstream life with cash, health cards and house sites.
beats.care: Police also seized 252 firearms, including 48 AK-47s, from surrendered cadres and dumps in the Karreguttalu hills.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Rewards for 96 more cadres will be released once Aadhaar and bank details come in.

cards.q: Should surrender rewards be paid faster?

qs: What happens to cadres who have no Aadhaar or bank account?

facts.t: *754* of the 824 surrendered cadres are from Chhattisgarh.
House sites are allotted to *10* of 59 Telangana natives so far.

viz.verdict: About 79% of sanctioned rewards paid so far

watch: Three senior Telangana Maoist leaders, including Ganapathi, remain underground, police say.

fact: Telangana Police paid *Rs 5.59 crore* in pending rewards to 214 surrendered Maoists
twist: Of 824 who surrendered since 2024, 754 are from Chhattisgarh; only 59 are from Telangana.
